p: Spirit of God hath made me: I confess the power of God, and am one of his, therefore you should hear me.
God's stead: Because Job had wished to dispute his cause with God, Job 16:21 so that he might do it without fear, Elihu says, he will reason in God's stead, whom he does not need to fear.
be heavy upon thee: I will not handle you so roughly as these others have done.
clean without transgression: He repeats Job's words, by which he protested his innocency in various places, but especially in the 13th, 16th and 30th chapters.
account of any of his matters: The cause of his judgments is not always declared to man.
once: Though God by various examples of his judgments speak to man, yet the reason for it is not known, yea and though God should speak yet is he not understood.
vision of the night: God, he says, speaks commonly, either by visions to teach us the cause of his judgments, of else by affliction or by his messenger.
sealeth their instruction: That is, determined to send on them.
pride from man: He shows for why God sends afflictions: to beat down man's pride, and to turn from evil.
life abhorreth bread: That is, his painful and miserable life.
to the destroyers: To them that will bury him.
messenger with him: A man sent from God to declare his will.

to shew unto man his uprightness: A singular man, and as one chosen out of a thousand, who is able to declare the great mercies of God to sinners: and in which man's righteousness stands, which is through the justice of Jesus Christ.
gracious unto him: He shows that it is a sure token of God's mercy toward sinners, when he causes his word to be preached to them.
Deliver him from going down to: That is, the minister will by the preaching of the word pronounce to him the forgiveness of his sins.

fresher than a child's: He will feel God's favour and rejoice; declaring by this in which stands the true joy of the faithful, and that God will restore him to health, which is a token of his blessing.
righteousness: God will forgive his sins, and accept him as just.
perverted that which was right: That is, done wickedly.
me not: But my sins have been the cause of God's wrath toward me.
He will deliver his soul from: God will forgive the penitent sinner.
oftentimes with man: Meaning, as often as a sinner repents.
thing to say: If you doubt anything, or see opportunity to speak against it.
justify thee: That is, to show you, in which mans justification consists.
